source.title: Development of High Temperature Multi-Layer Laser Flash Artefacts
source.publisher: National Physical Laboratory / International Journal of Thermophysics
source.material: IG-210 grade isotropic graphite from Toyo Tanso
source.batch_statement: The article states that this IG-210 batch was used in an intercomparison between Hi-Trace partners.
source.temperature_scope: 500 C, 700 C, and 1000 C Table 1 thermophysical values
source_locators: PDF page 7, Section 4.1, Table 1: property methods and uncertainty labels
PDF page 7, Table 1, 500 C column: density, specific heat, diffusivity, alpha_l, and thermal conductivity
PDF page 7, Table 1, 700 C column: density, specific heat, diffusivity, alpha_l, and thermal conductivity
PDF page 7, Table 1, 1000 C column: density, specific heat, diffusivity, alpha_l, and thermal conductivity
PDF page 7, Table 1 footnote: higher-temperature density values use thermal-expansion corrections
source.material_regime_limit: IG-210 is a manufactured isotropic graphite grade; equivalence to Ding natural-graphite TTG/PBTE state is not established.

preprocessing.selection_policy: Table 1 rows at 500 C, 700 C, and 1000 C only
preprocessing.unit_normalization: retain SI-compatible source units; thermal diffusivity values are converted from table x 10^-6 m^2 s^-1 notation to m^2 s^-1
preprocessing.density_policy: retain source density values and source footnote that higher-temperature values use thermal-expansion corrections
preprocessing.alpha_volume_policy: alpha_V = 3*alpha_l is a conditional isotropic geometry comparator and is not source-reported
preprocessing.cp_cv_policy: retain C_p; do not relabel as C_v; c_v^V = rho*(C_p - T*alpha_V^2*K_T) remains open
preprocessing.uncertainty_policy: retain expanded relative source bounds at k=2; conductivity range 8-10 percent remains a range

derived_comparator.project_lineage_to_other_Hi_Trace_source: project-level lineage only; no silent row-level identity is asserted

claim_boundary: This package closes only a source-traceable IG-210 thermophysical comparator with density, C_p, diffusivity, alpha_l, and stated source uncertainty. It is not C_v, not a same-state K_T pair, not Ding C_src, not alpha_Phi_K calibration, and not Full Topic 13 closure.
